positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with six technology departments (Security, Service Management, System Administration, Enterprise Applications,Field Services, EPMO (Enterprise Project Management Office) during a six-month rotation, and completed the internship with an additional six month focus on Retirement Applications team.
    • Utilized and developed proficiency in the ITSM software ServiceNow to categorize incident and problem tickets enterprise wide, ensuring proper group permissions and problem solving for solutions.
    • Designed with Directors and Managers a system to increase efficiency of new hire onboarding and security authentication.
    • Supported various security applications to ensure enterprise wide data security.
    • Along with the System Administration team, created automation scripts and an AI program to streamline company-wide processes.
    • Aided the Application Retirement Team and third-party vendors in maintaining legacy systems, using industry tools to verify database integrity, and testing to ensure stability of systems.
